import re, math

from_email='connorbrow@gmail.com'
queries=['flight','ticket','receipt','amount','owed','reimburse','payment','share','bill','venmo']
page_limit=20

thread_ids=set()
thread_summaries=[]

for q in queries:
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(
            access_token=gmail_token,
            from_email=from_email,
            query=q,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit,
            sort_by='-created_at'
        )
        if not page:
            break
        for t in page:
            thread_ids.add(t['email_thread_id'])
        print('query',q,'page',page_index,'len',len(page))
        page_index+=1
        if len(page)<page_limit:
            break

print('unique_thread_ids',len(thread_ids))
print(sorted(thread_ids))

# Fetch threads and scan bodies for currency amounts
for tid in sorted(thread_ids):
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=gmail_token,email_thread_id=tid)
    # Some threads may include multiple emails; concatenate bodies
    bodies=[]
    for e in th.get('emails',[]):
        bodies.append(e.get('body','') or '')
    full='\n'.join(bodies)
    amounts=re.findall(r'\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', full)
    if amounts or (th.get('emails') and any('receipt' in (e.get('subject','').lower()+' '+(e.get('body','').lower() if e.get('body') else '')) for e in th.get('emails',[]))):
        # Print representative snippet for verification
        subject=th.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('subject') if th.get('emails') else th.get('label')
        created=th.get('created_at') or (th.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('created_at') if th.get('emails') else None)
        snippet=full.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:200]
        thread_summaries.append((tid,created,subject,amounts,snippet))

# Sort by created_at string desc
thread_summaries.sort(key=lambda x: x[1] or '', reverse=True)
for s in thread_summaries:
    print('tid',s[0],'created',s[1],'subject',s[2],'amounts',s[3],'snippet',s[4])

def scan_text(txt):
    txt=txt or ''
    dollar=re.findall(r'\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', txt)
    # also capture patterns like 'USD 123.45' or 'dollars 123'
    usd=re.findall(r'\bUSD\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\b', txt, flags=re.I)
    dollars=re.findall(r'\bdollars?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\b', txt, flags=re.I)
    # capture any number with decimal or integer near words owed/reimburse/share/flight/ticket
    near_numbers=re.findall(r'(?:owed|reimburse|share|ticket|flight|total|amount)[^0-9]{0,20}([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', txt, flags=re.I)
    # any standalone number (too broad) just for debugging
    nums=re.findall(r'(?<!%)\b([0-9]{2,6}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\b', txt)
    return {'dollar':dollar,'usd':usd,'dollars':dollars,'near_numbers':near_numbers,'nums_sample':nums[:20]}
